segments.name: Service delivery and clinical stage research
segments.description: Clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing oral small molecule therapies for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis treatment.
segments.evidence: Only one operating segment arises from the management reporting system: service delivery and clinical stage research, notably into potential therapies in the areas of fibrosis, lysosomal storage disorders and oncology.

revenueModel.text: Revenue from research and development service delivery and licensing arrangements with collaborators and licensees.
revenueModel.evidence: Purchasing transactions in foreign currencies are presented in operating income as they relate to the Company's ordinary activities.
